Paradise Found

Episode 3

Unknown to Moriyama, Izumi is quite the nympho but goes along with her dangerous advances...

Yuutousei ni Hitsuyou na Jugyou

Even if they want to have erotic encounters, there are certain dangers with paid dating and random guys so Hinamachi-san decided to hire a tutor for ecchi purposes instead!
